name: HC27a: Total Eligible
description:
Number of pregnant or breastfeeding women who are active on ART and whose 3-month anniversary after ART initiation falls within the reporting period.
The patient must have a documented art_start_date, the date three months after ART initiation must fall between :startDate and :endDate, the patient must be present in the HIV ART summary, must satisfy the active-on-ART rule through an ART encounter during the reporting period or return_visit_date > :endDate, and the latest ART-card assessment on or before :endDate must indicate PREGNANT or Breast feeding.
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f

FROM mamba_fact_patients_latest_regimen r

  AND DATE_ADD(r.art_start_date, INTERVAL 3 MONTH)

  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s

      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a

            )
            OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )

        AND (
            FIND_IN_SET(
                'PREGNANT',
                REPLACE(a.pregnancy_status, ', ', ',')
            ) > 0
            OR FIND_IN_SET(
                'Breast feeding',
                REPLACE(a.pregnancy_status, ', ', ',')
            ) > 0
        )

        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card x
            WHERE x.patient_id = a.patient_id
              AND x.encounter_date > a.encounter_date
              AND x.encounter_date <= :endDate
        )
  );",

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT r.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_patients_latest_regimen r
WHERE r.art_start_date IS NOT NULL

  AND DATE_ADD(r.art_start_date, INTERVAL 3 MONTH) >= :startDate
  AND DATE_ADD(r.art_start_date, INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
      < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s
      WHERE s.patient_id = r.patient_id
  )

  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
      WHERE a.patient_id = r.patient_id
        AND a.encounter_date <= :endDate

        AND (
            (
                a.encounter_date >= :startDate
                AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
            )
            OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )

        AND (
            FIND_IN_SET(
                'PREGNANT',
                REPLACE(a.pregnancy_status, ', ', ',')
            ) > 0
            OR FIND_IN_SET(
                'Breast feeding',
                REPLACE(a.pregnancy_status, ', ', ',')
            ) > 0
        )

        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card x
            WHERE x.patient_id = a.patient_id
              AND x.encounter_date > a.encounter_date
              AND x.encounter_date <= :endDate
        )
  );
